title: AltWindowCycle: address #50494 review feedback (click-through, memory, fallback, footer bar)

proposed_comments.title: Flush GDI+ output before page-indicator compositing
proposed_comments.body:
### Flush GDI+ output before page-indicator compositing

**Severity:** `high`

The transparent page-indicator path reads and blends the DIB pixels directly, but the preceding GDI+ drawing is still buffered when `DrawHeaderText` starts. That can blend the text against stale pixels, and the later flush can overwrite the indicator. Flush the graphics before this direct pixel access, as the other direct-buffer paths already do.

```suggestion
            g.Flush();
            DrawHeaderText(static_cast<BYTE*>(bits), w, h, font, pageRc, pageText,
```

confidence.rationale: The live diff calls DrawHeaderText on the DIB before the only later GDI+ flush, and the helper directly reads and writes those backing pixels.

proposed_comments.title: Treat downsample failures as capture failures
proposed_comments.body:
### Treat downsample failures as capture failures

**Severity:** `medium`

`CaptureWindowSnapshotForPreview` currently checks only the destination bitmap status after calling `Graphics::DrawImage`. If the draw operation itself fails while the bitmap remains allocated, the slot is treated as a valid snapshot and the DWM fallback is skipped, leaving a blank preview. Check the `DrawImage` status and return `nullptr` so `RegisterThumbnails` can use its existing live-thumbnail fallback.

```suggestion
        if (tg.DrawImage(full.get(),
                         Gdiplus::RectF(0.0f, 0.0f, static_cast<Gdiplus::REAL>(dw), static_cast<Gdiplus::REAL>(dh)),
                         srcLeft,
                         srcTop,
                         srcW,
                         srcH,
                         Gdiplus::UnitPixel) != Gdiplus::Ok)
        {
            return nullptr;
        }
```

confidence.rationale: The live diff adds a DrawImage operation but ignores its status; only the bitmap allocation status is checked afterward, so draw failure can bypass the existing fallback.

proposed_comments.title: Name the inset header geometry accurately
proposed_comments.body:
### Name the inset header geometry accurately

**Severity:** `low`

The test name says both rectangles are flush edge-to-edge, but the header assertion is intentionally inset (`44..320`) inside the tile (`32..332`) while only the preview is flush. Rename the test so a failure communicates the actual layout contract.

```suggestion
        TEST_METHOD(TilePreviewIsFlushAndHeaderIsInsetWithinTile)
```

confidence.rationale: The live RIGHT-side test name says flush edge-to-edge while its own assertions use an inset header rectangle; the corrected name is directly supported by the changed assertions.
